ashley: Quick async — kernel latency tuning yesterday, p95 down ~8% after qopt patch. Blocker: flaky repro on shard-7 (OOM at step 42). Today: CI canary + perf bench, will open PR for microbatch heuristic. cc @ravi @tom

 tom: Nice. Can you paste the bench command / config?

 ashley: bench command: ./perf_runner --scenario=kv-heavy --iters=200 --batch-size=8
 config: slot_timeout=15ms, prefetch=on

 ravi: I pulled logs from shard-7, saw OOM on step 42. Stack: `kv_cache::evict()` spiking mem. I'll attach snippet later. Possible race with concurrent eviction.

 maya: Heads up: I rolled out small patch to cache eviction backoff to canary (region-us-east-1). Observability shows drop in evict spikes.

 ashley: Thanks Maya — can you link the deploy? Also which canary hosts?

 maya: Deployed via deploy-bot: https://deploys.internal/release/2026-03-18-evict-backoff
 Hosts: evict-canary-[03,04]

 ops-bot: Alert: shard-7 experienced 5xx burst at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z — rate-limited fallback triggered.

 tom: Re: bench config — try lowering batch-size to 6 for the canary to reduce KV contention.

 ravi: I'll spin up a repro with `BATCH_SIZE=6 ./run_repro.sh` and feed with trace from shard-7. ETA ~1.5h.

 ashley: I'll queue the canary perf run after Ravi's repro. If repro stable, PR ready for review @tom.

 tom: I'll review PR once CI passes. Quick note: add a microbenchmark to `bench-suite/kvs_eviction.py` to capture mem footprint.

 maya: On docs: updated runtime tuning doc with note about prefetchoff for large seqs -> https://docs.internal/runtime/tuning#kv

 ashley: :thumbsup: thanks all. Blocker for me: waiting on repro logs from Ravi.

 ravi: uploaded logs: s3://redwood-logs/shard7/evict-step42.log
 Link: https://s3.internal/redwood-logs/shard7/evict-step42.log

 tom: Got logs, starting local run.

 maria: FYI I'm on support rotation, will watch alerts and ping if the canary flips over.

 ashley: Final: plan today — finish PR, run canary perf, and sync in next standup thread. If any hot failures ping me @ashley.
